purpose: Prospectively test whether low pre-decision separation predicts sham-calibrated resolved-action divergence when learned-recommender shelves are deterministic and treatment opportunity is present.
studyRole: Outcome-blind, opportunity-enriched mechanism stress test; not a population-prevalence estimate.
taskSource: Use the committed 32-task manifest selected without reading LLM responses or resolved-action outcomes.
recommenderAllocation: Use modelFamily and modelSeed from the committed selected-task manifest.

generation.privacy: Send pseudonymous candidate IDs and derived constraint, utility, rank, and novelty features only.

primaryEstimands.resolvedActionDivergence: Final selected item or abandon outcome differs between immediate-remove and held-outcome.
primaryEstimands.persistentResolvedActionFeedback: Resolved action diverges and next-task Top-10 displacement is greater than zero.
primaryEstimands.shamPersistentResolvedActionFeedback: The same event in held-sham-a versus held-sham-b.
primaryEstimands.mechanismAuc: Probability that an exposure event has a smaller frozen predictor than a non-event; ties count as one half.

pilotGate.reliability: Valid-action rate at least 0.95 and timeout rate below 0.05 for each provider.
pilotGate.sham: DeepSeek sham persistent resolved-action rate at most 0.05.
pilotGate.eventSupport: At least four DeepSeek persistent resolved-action exposure events.
pilotGate.discrimination: DeepSeek mechanism AUC at least 0.70 and one-sided exact label-permutation p at most 0.10.
pilotGate.concentration: At least two thirds of DeepSeek exposure events fall in the bottom predictor tertile.
pilotGate.mimoBoundary: Report MiMo descriptively as the prospective near-zero boundary; do not require a positive MiMo effect.
pilotGate.stop: If any primary DeepSeek gate fails, do not add a third LLM family or scale beyond 32 tasks.

privacy: Public output excludes original item IDs, titles, reviews, prompts, provider responses, and pseudonymous candidate aliases.
claimBoundary: A passing result supports the proposed mechanism on an opportunity-enriched research-storefront task set. It does not estimate natural prevalence, human behavior, or production-retailer effects.
